history_action.name: history_action
history_action.value:
("app"."history"."category" = 'stock' AND "app"."history"."action" IN ('add', 'remove', 'adjust', 'move', 'share', 'unshare', 'give', 'split', 'merge'))
    OR ("app"."history"."category" = 'refinery' AND "app"."history"."action" IN ('start', 'done', 'remove', 'adjust'))
    OR ("app"."history"."category" = 'blueprint' AND "app"."history"."action" IN ('add', 'remove'))

history_users.name: history_users
history_users.value:
"app"."history"."actor_user_id" ~ '^[0-9]{17,20}$' AND "app"."history"."owner_user_id" ~ '^[0-9]{17,20}$'
    AND ("app"."history"."to_owner_user_id" IS NULL OR "app"."history"."to_owner_user_id" ~ '^[0-9]{17,20}$') AND ("app"."history"."guild_id" IS NULL OR "app"."history"."guild_id" ~ '^[0-9]{17,20}$')

stock_batch_kind.name: stock_batch_kind
stock_batch_kind.value:
("app"."stock_batch"."kind" = 'resource' AND "app"."stock_batch"."resource_uuid" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."stock_batch"."item_uuid" IS NULL)
    OR ("app"."stock_batch"."kind" = 'item' AND "app"."stock_batch"."item_uuid" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."stock_batch"."resource_uuid" IS NULL)

stock_batch_refine_job.name: stock_batch_refine_job
stock_batch_refine_job.value:
"app"."stock_batch"."state" = 'refining' OR ("app"."stock_batch"."refine_started_at" IS NULL
    AND "app"."stock_batch"."refine_ends_at" IS NULL)

stock_journal_kind.name: stock_journal_kind
stock_journal_kind.value:
("app"."stock_journal"."kind" = 'resource' AND "app"."stock_journal"."resource_uuid" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."stock_journal"."item_uuid" IS NULL)
    OR ("app"."stock_journal"."kind" = 'item' AND "app"."stock_journal"."item_uuid" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."stock_journal"."resource_uuid" IS NULL)

guild_board_title_length.name: guild_board_title_length
guild_board_title_length.value: "bot"."guild"."board_title" IS NULL OR char_length("bot"."guild"."board_title") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

blueprint_input_kind.name: blueprint_input_kind
blueprint_input_kind.value:
("catalog"."blueprint_input"."kind" = 'resource' AND "catalog"."blueprint_input"."resource_uuid" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog"."blueprint_input"."item_uuid" IS NULL)
    OR ("catalog"."blueprint_input"."kind" = 'item' AND "catalog"."blueprint_input"."item_uuid" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog"."blueprint_input"."resource_uuid" IS NULL)

catalog.localization_effective.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.lang, l.key) l.lang, l.key, l.value, l.source
  FROM "catalog"."localization" l
  JOIN "catalog"."localization_source" s ON s.source = l.source AND s.lang = l.lang
  ORDER BY l.lang, l.key, s.priority DESC, l.source
catalog.localization_effective.name: localization_effective
